name: Paying Bills On Time
overview: Scripture teaches the importance of timely and faithful payment of debts and obligations as an expression of integrity and love. Deuteronomy 24:15 commands paying workers promptly to avoid sin, while Romans 13:7 urges rendering to all what is owed, including financial dues. Additionally, Romans 13:8 encourages believers to owe nothing except love, highlighting that fulfilling obligations honors God's law. Malachi 3:10 illustrates the blessings that come from faithful giving, reinforcing the principle that responsible stewardship and honoring commitments invite God's provision.
